Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling southbound in the left lane of the intersection in Conroe, Texas, when the collision occurred.
Driver 2 was eastbound and entered the intersection as the signal changed, striking the driver side of Driver 1's
vehicle. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle at the time of impact. Both drivers
and the Passenger were interviewed at the scene, and Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash. Driver 2
stated the collision happened as Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses gave accounts that matched the
physical evidence. Scene photographs show the point of impact and the resting positions of both vehicles. Officers
observed no prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle, and the registered policy holder is listed as Driver 1. The extent of the
damage to the rear quarter panel and the rear passenger door could not be fully determined from the impact alone,
and further inspection will be needed to establish whether all of it resulted from this collision. Driver 1 was transported
to a local medical facility for evaluation.
